# Ayush Dutta - Security Researcher & Developer

> Security researcher & developer. Platform & security at Atlan, Linux Foundation LFX'26 mentee at Magma. NixOS, agentic harnesses, reproducible machines, accessible security. Zero-JS portfolio drawn with ascii.rest at berzi.one.

## About

Passionate about cybersecurity, agentic engineering and making security education accessible. I work on platform and security at Atlan, and contribute to Magma through the Linux Foundation mentorship. I ship every few days on GitHub, mostly experiments built from niche technology, or to prove a point that it can be done.

## Projects

- [lemonx](https://github.com/Spirizeon/lemonx): agentic AI testing platform that generates, executes and fixes unit, integration and E2E tests for TypeScript/JavaScript codebases
- [yuki-code](https://github.com/Spirizeon/yuki-code): Nix-based harness for reproducible agent sessions for AI engineering teams
- [berzinix](https://github.com/Spirizeon/berzinix): fully-declarative NixOS + Hyprland config on flakes and home-manager, NVIDIA GPU
- [agentic-aeo-skills](https://github.com/Spirizeon/agentic-aeo-skills): LLM-first AEO analysis skillset with 6 specialized sub-skills and 6 specialist agents
- [hackfish](https://github.com/Spirizeon/hackfish): swarm intelligence to predict your next hackathon winning project
- [shovel](https://github.com/Spirizeon/shovel): memory-efficient, fast web crawler using goroutines
- [superminimalism](https://github.com/Spirizeon/superminimalism): the portfolio site you are reading, hand-written HTML drawn with ascii.rest
